script-module-step.description: Sweeps customer profiles modified since the last Gameball sync and upserts the changed ones to Gameball. Covers the entry points SFCC gives no hook for: Business Manager profile edits and customer import jobs. Also retries any inline sync that previously failed.

status.description: Used when the step failed with an error.
Used when the step finished successfully.

script-module-step.description: Deletes customers from Gameball for whom a right-to-be-forgotten request was captured. Gameball's delete is a HARD delete with no undo. Schedule this job on exactly ONE site: its Custom Object is organization-scoped, so a second site's instance would only produce redundant calls. See docs/gameball-gdpr.md.

status.description: Used when the step failed with an error.
Used when the step finished successfully.

script-module-step.description: Re-attempts Gameball order tracking for orders left in gbTrackState FAILED by a transient API failure, bounded by a per-order attempt cap and a per-run call cap. Also verifies (rather than blindly re-sends) an order whose previous failure was ambiguous, e.g. a timeout.

status.description: Used when the step failed with an error.
Used when the step finished successfully.
